panels.title: Admission and dependency health
panels.interpretation: Local lifecycle flag; show dependency_available alongside it.

panels.title: Dependency availability
panels.interpretation: Last probe; use scraper up/freshness and probe count.

panels.title: Dependency probe p95
panels.interpretation: Distribution resolution; no final SLO threshold.

panels.title: Command latency p95
panels.interpretation: Includes owning port work. No raw command label.

panels.title: Command failures by stable code
panels.interpretation: Expected state/rule conflicts separate from INTERNAL_ERROR.

panels.title: Auth rejection ratio
panels.interpretation: Includes expected unauthenticated checks; investigate endpoint mix in safe logs.

panels.title: Active sockets
panels.interpretation: Process-local counters; aggregate socket count.

panels.title: Node-distinct connected accounts
panels.interpretation: Show per instance; summing is not global CCU.

panels.title: Active Matches
panels.interpretation: Shared DB snapshots; do not sum replicas.

panels.title: Waiting/full Rooms
panels.query: max(hambazi_rooms_waiting{service="api"} and on(service,instance,job) (hambazi_collection_success{collector="rooms"} == 1)) + max(hambazi_rooms_full{service="api"} and on(service,instance,job) (hambazi_collection_success{collector="rooms"} == 1))
panels.interpretation: Stored states, after owning expiry transitions.

panels.title: Retained finished/terminated Matches
panels.interpretation: Gate on matches validity; gauges reflect retained truth, not attempt counters.

panels.title: Durable matchmaking wait/backlog
panels.interpretation: Gate on admissions validity; durable unexpired tickets and oldest waiting age.

panels.title: Recorded reconnects/disconnects/Bot replacements
panels.query: (hambazi_reconnects_recorded or hambazi_disconnects_recorded or hambazi_bot_takeovers_recorded) and on(service,instance,job) (hambazi_collection_success{collector="matches"} == 1)
panels.interpretation: Durable event count gauges; show per instance, do not sum replicas.

panels.title: DB pool utilization
panels.interpretation: Per-process saturation; gate on database validity and pair with pool_waiting.

panels.title: DB operation p95
panels.interpretation: Includes acquisition/transaction callback settlement; not individual SQL duration.

panels.title: Oldest pending outbox age
panels.interpretation: Gate on outbox validity; pending includes leases/backoff. Inspect failed count.

panels.title: Queue waiting/delayed/failed
panels.query: (hambazi_queue_waiting or hambazi_queue_delayed or hambazi_queue_failed) and on(service,instance,job) (hambazi_collection_success{collector="queues"} == 1)
panels.interpretation: Gate on queues validity; queue totals are shared snapshots, do not sum replicas.

panels.title: Drain failures
panels.interpretation: Short-lived process series; retain lifecycle logs/supervisor exit status too.

panels.title: Reporter failures/drops
panels.interpretation: Best effort; no spool/retry. Reports optional.

panels.title: Collection health
panels.interpretation: Never treat stale/failed samples as healthy zero.
